description: Creates or edits a printed 5x7 postcard with a front greeting, optional photo, back message and sign-off. Downloads an attached photo or public HTTPS photo URL to cards.onmax.me. Without a photo, the greeting appears on a solid color. An existing design_id edits that design; omitted fields remain unchanged. The back message is user-written or user-approved text of up to 500 characters. Arranges supplied photos and text in a print template without generating images.

greeting.description: Front headline, e.g. "Happy Holidays", "Merry Christmas", "Thank You".

photo.description: Photo the user attached for the front.

photo_url.description: Public https URL of the front photo.

sign_off.description: Signature on the back, e.g. "Love, The Garcias".

style.description: classic (red), evergreen (green), winter (blue), minimal (white), thanks (warm, for thank-you cards).

name: design_card
title: Design card
